description: Wasserstraßen (HAD) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.bafg.de. Contrary to the representations in previous atlases and official maps, the inland waterways were not classified according to administrative affiliation or the common classification scheme, which is primarily determined by ship-related data. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Waterways (HAD)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
